specs.title: the account menu closes when focus leaves it by Tab or Shift+Tab
two amounts in one question to Ask: the draft cannot be signed until the owner accepts the contradiction, and the acceptance is signed
a proposal from Ask opened in the editor asks the owner each time, whatever run mode was proposed
Ask proposes a standing policy for the on-chain wallet; the owner signs its exact terms once and it runs on the chain
a conversation: two things asked become two drafts at once, a correction replaces a proposal, and "cancel that" withdraws without asking the model
a shared vault needs two different members' passkeys: the owner's alone sends nothing, the second member's completes it, for acceptance, a mandate and a payment
an instruction in a two-signature business takes effect only when a second member signs the same document
a lowering of who must sign waits, every member who may sign sees it on the workspace page, and one of them cancels it
the price chart states its question, answers it with exact values, gives a table and its source, and reads a point under a finger on a phone

an earning job between two fresh households through the screens: offered, funded from the client's wallet, delivered and verified on the chain, the provider paid, the authority it earned shown honestly, and a second milestone released back to the client
a household reads the evidence for its own wallet operation, step by step, and its hashes check out in the browser; another household cannot open it
the recorded evidence of the approved release is readable without a wallet, labelled historical, counted as the manifests count it, and linked to the public explorer
a schedule that asks for more than its monthly limit must be accepted point by point before signing, and the acceptance is signed
by keyboard alone: create an account with a passkey, open the household, pause QED and resume
by keyboard alone: set up the on-chain vault, accept it, sign a mandate and pay, each signed by the passkey
a look-alike payee is named as one before it is added and before a payment to it is signed
a payment the rail never answers is shown as unanswered, not done or failed, with the money held; a declined one says so and that the money came back
a fresh account is created with a passkey and no password, shows ten recovery codes once, and the database agrees
signs out and back in with the passkey; a sign-in without user verification is refused
a saved code and a contact’s code start a recovery that the signed-in owner sees and cancels; it can then not be completed
a recovery left alone completes after the delay with a new passkey, and shows a new set of saved codes once; the old ones stop working
a stolen passkey is suspended at once from another: its session ends and it can no longer sign in
a password account changes its password, then removes it once it has a passkey and an active recovery contact
a paused QED refuses a wallet-policy tick asked for on the policy page and nothing on the vault changes; resumed, the tick runs
presentation mode: every screen says its values are synthetic, and nothing from a live provider is in the database or named as a source
an order estimate says when and where it was priced, counts down, and cannot be signed once it has lapsed (R7-094)
an order’s receipt states its reference price, spread, average, fee and what was delivered, and that the ledger moved exactly that (R7-096)
an order larger than the book fills in part: the estimate says so first, the record says what filled and that the rest was cancelled, and the ledger moved only what filled (R7-101)
the readiness view names the build and its release, and is never ready while a blocker remains
a finished payment whose rail record differs is shown as needing attention wherever it appears, never as done
one session ends another from the security screen: the other is signed out at once, this one stays
a password account sets up, signs in again, and can approve nothing until it adds a passkey
the bank statement downloads as a CSV that equals the ledger, and a formula-like name is written as text
a plain pause holds protective selling too; keeping it is a choice the sheet names and the record keeps

two households side by side: each pays, converts, sets money aside and signs a policy; one earns from the other through the escrow; one paused, one drained, a scenario; neither reaches the other; after a restart of every service the screens equal the chain and the passkey still signs
two households keep their own vaults across a restart of every service; a paused vault stays paused and its passkey still signs

a second passkey becomes a wallet signer, its removal is scheduled and cancelled by the other passkey, a recovery key is set up in the browser without the code leaving it, and a recovery started with that code is stopped by a signer
a fresh household sets up its own vault, owned by its passkey; accepting it, a mandate and a payment are each signed by the passkey and checked on the chain
two households: each has its own vault and owner account, and one pausing its vault leaves the other's untouched
Spend, Save and Grow act on the on-chain wallet in place: each signed with the passkey over exact terms, followed on the page, and each change equal on the chain
